name: orleans
description: Skills for Microsoft Orleans 10 development including the result pattern, the multiservice modular-monolith pattern and multitenancy.

interface.shortDescription: Microsoft Orleans skills — result pattern, modular-monolith multiservice and multitenancy
interface.longDescription: Use Orleans to access reusable skills for Microsoft Orleans 10 development, covering a concise version-tolerant result pattern for grain calls, a modular-monolith multiservice pattern for painless logical-to-physical service separation, and multitenancy with per-tenant grain storage and tenant separation of grain calls and streams.
defaultPrompt: Use the Orleans plugin to help implement the result pattern, the modular-monolith multiservice pattern or multitenancy in Orleans 10.
